name: Appalify for Woocommerce
author: Appalify

sections.description:
Appalify for Woocommerce is the only woocommerce extension you’ll ever need!

Features:
– pre-orders
– quick view
Since we are currently in our early stages we are constantly working on making this plugin better and adding more features.
If you are missing some core features, don’t be afraid to send us an email at team@appalify.com.

Requirements:
– WordPress
– Woocommerce
sections.installation:
Installing “Appalify for Woocommerce” can be done either by searching for “Appalify for Woocommerce” via the “Plugins > Add New” screen in your WordPress dashboard, or by using the following steps:

  1. Download the plugin via WordPress.org
  2. Upload the ZIP file through the ‘Plugins > Add New > Upload’ screen in your WordPress dashboard
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
What is Appalify for Woocommerce?

Appalify is an All-In-One Woocommerce bundle that will allow you to add many features to completely customize your Wooocommerce store.
